I made the next converter block cv3. cv2 finished cleanly, and the one thing it found is now filed as an emitter bug. I committed locally (9f3c49a2) but did not push, although the task's step 2 says to. Pushing now would also send cv2's three commits (72e7789c, db8d8364, 8b125868), and the driver's full suite has not passed on them yet; my own instructions also say the main session pushes. The driver should push after its suite run.

- **Why the run stopped:** cv2 (text cuts) is done and passed its checks, but its report named a defect outside its change, and that stops a batch. The defect: `code_on_a_cycle` in `emit_reach.nika` still builds its graph from one file only. 72e7789c fixed the same blind spot for the pausing graph while cv2 was being built.
- **Bug confirmed and filed:** a two-file scratch package fails in rustc with "Reached the recursion limit while instantiating `ping`". The one-file version runs and prints `1`. Filed as #1129 (`ready`, `wip`) with that probe, the traced location and the steps to build. Its bug brief `docs/briefs/bugs/b31-1129-code-cycle-across-files.md` (`effort: low`, the fix follows 72e7789c) is appended to `docs/briefs/bugs/batch.txt`. It blocks nothing: no converter brief needs it now.
- **Converter batch:** `docs/briefs/converter/batch.txt` now holds only `cv3-loop-tail-and-field-patterns.md`. After cv3, S1 waits on nothing in this lane. The report is at `docs/briefs/converter/architect-task.md.report.md`.
- **Process fix:** cv2 spent about half its run on that emitter defect. I added a trap to `docs/builder-facts.md`: a package is lowered file by file, so a new call between two of its files can hit an analysis that reads one file; probe it first as a two-file package. The same entry names rs2nika's existing helpers (`text_expr`, `field_ty`, `self.fails`) that cv2 had to look up. The converter part of the *State* section in `docs/architect.md` is updated.
- **Leftover file:** `docs/briefs/converter/qa-input.txt` (12:06) is from an earlier red run that QA already handled; it is not this cut.

**Start next:** `docs/briefs/converter/cv3-loop-tail-and-field-patterns.md`, builder on Sonnet with `effort: medium`, the last converter pattern S1 needs.

**Needs from the main session:** push after the suite passes. **Owner:** nothing to decide.
